comment: SPEC §5.4. With CONTENT_POLICY=general (default) games carrying one of `denyTags` (IFDB tags, case-insensitive) are left out. `exclude` removes games by hand under every policy: IFDB tagging is incomplete. Each entry: { "tuid": "…", "reason": "…" }. `languages` sets a game's language by hand (S2.6), after the rule that reads the chosen file's description, for cases the rule cannot read: { "<tuid>": { "language": "en", "reason": "…" } }; overrides naming no kept game are reported.
